title: Mutsivi Akagadzwa
intro: Munhu wekare akagadzirira kupinda munhoroondo. Nzira payakaita seisina kujeka uye kusava nechokwadi kwakapararira pakati pevanhu, muranda uyu akasarudzwa kuti atungamirirwe. Nekurema kwebasa dzvene pamafudzi avo, vakafamba vachitungamira uko vamwe vaizeza kutevera.
clues: Ndakasarudzwa kuti ndiende nemuporofita uye ndakadzidza kubva kuuchenjeri hwavo
Ndakamira pamberi peAreka apo vimbiso yeMutsigiri wedu yakaswedera pedyo, uye ndakaona vanhu vachitanga kusava nechokwadi
Ndakamiswa pamucheto wezvakavimbiswa uku mutungamiri wedu achichema uye achitikumbira kuna Allah
Ndakagadzwa kuti ndienderere mberi nebasa rakapihwa kune mumwe munhu asati anditangira.
Ndakapiwa simba raMwari rekutungamira vanhu kunzvimbo dzavaienda
Ndakabudirira kupedzisa zvakanga zvatanga pamberi pangu, uye ndakagamuchira chisimbiso chevanhu chekutungamirirwa kwangu
arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
